headline: Supreme Infrastructure India schedules 43rd AGM for November 12
hook: Annual meeting scheduled for Supreme Infrastructure
summary: Supreme Infrastructure India has announced that its 43rd Annual General Meeting will be held on November 12. The company has set November 6 as the start date for the book closure period. This process is a standard procedural requirement for listed companies to finalize the list of shareholders eligible for voting and dividends.
why_it_matters: Routine procedural update with no direct impact on share price.

headline: Supreme Infrastructure sets 43rd AGM for November 2026
hook: Routine procedural filing from Supreme Infrastructure
summary: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited has scheduled its 43rd Annual General Meeting for November 12, 2026. The meeting will be conducted virtually through video conferencing or other audio-visual means. Retail investors holding the stock should note the corporate event date. Such routine AGM notices do not impact the company's financial fundamentals.
why_it_matters: No financial impact for retail investors.

headline: Supreme Infrastructure gets extension to hold AGM
hook: AGM delayed for small-cap infrastructure firm
summary: Supreme Infrastructure India Limited has received approval from the Registrar of Companies in Mumbai to extend its Annual General Meeting deadline. The company now has until November 15, 2026, to hold the AGM for the financial year ending March 31, 2026. The extension grants an additional one month and 15 days beyond the standard timeline. For retail investors, delayed AGMs can indicate administrative backlogs or reporting delays within financially distressed micro-cap companies.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance delay for a distressed micro-cap company.
